DILG Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wmw.dilg.com.ph DILG OPINION No. 28 s. 2022 April 26, 2022 MR. ORLANDO MARQUEZ National President Liga ng Transportasyon at Operators saPiIipinas Tel # 09985743574 Dear Mr. Marquez: This has reference to your letter dated II March 2022wherein you discussed your concerns regarding the non-contact apprehension being implemented by different local government units (LGUs). It is your contention that such system defeats the purpose of demerit system to the Driver's License under Republic Act No. 10930, otherwise known as the Land Transportation and Traffic Code, since the driver of the vehicle would be escaping its liability for the reason that the person being summoned and ultimately penalized under the policy are the operators and/or registered owners, as they are the ones required to pay accumulated fines and penalties as a pre-requisite before they can renew the annual registration of their vehicles. It is in this regard that the Liga ng Transportasyon at Operators saPilipinas is seeking this Department's guidance regarding the legality and viability of the non- contact apprehension policy being implemented by various LGUs. At the outset, we would like to stress that this Department is an agency under the executive branch of the government and as such, it has no authority to declare invalid any ordinance or resolution of the local sanggunians, or any act committed by the members thereof which is alleged to be in violation of Republic Act No. 7160 otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991" (LGC) or other applicable laws. Only the courts have the authority to do so upon initiation of the appropriate action. Moreover, this Department is proscribed, under our internal rules as provided in Memorandum Circular No. 2010-02, t) act on queries of the following kind, to wit: enacted presumptively valid acts. "2. Those e.q. ordinances.consummated acts that already eniov the presumption of on the part of the public officer concerned and similar instances; xxx"

In view thereof, we shall discuss only the provisions of law or rules which we deem applicable based on the representations in the letter. We deem it proper to highlight that LGUs are empowered to promote public welfare as provided under Section 16 of Republic Act No. 7160, otherwise known as the "Local Government Code of 1991", as amended, to wit: "SECTION 16. General Welfare. — Every local government unit shall exercise the powers expressly granted. those necessarilv implied therefrom. as well as powers necessary, appropriate. or incidental for its efficient and effective qovernance. and those which are essential to the promotion of the qeneral welfare. Within their respective territorial jurisdictions, local government units shall ensure and support, among other things. maintain peace and order, and preserve the comfort and convenience of their inhabitants. " In view of the above-quoted provision, while we recognize that under the pohcy, the actual drivers who have committed violations are not the ones ultimately punished, and that it appears to be inconsistent with the demerit system to the driver's license under Republic Act No. 10930, yet, we would like to state that so long as the power is exercised for the interest of the public in general, as distinguished from those of a particular class, and that the means employed is reasonably necessary for the accomplishment of the purpose, not unduly oppressive on individuals, and they are afforded due process, the LGUs may validly implement the policy. Note however, that as to viability, we are of the considered view that the LGUs, in implementing the policy, shall ensure that there would be appropriate guidelines regarding the area/coverage of operation, notification system on how to promptly and correctly inform the violators, and the procedure on how and where to contest the alleged violations. Albeit the foregoing, we would like to reiterate that this opinion is being issued without prejudice to any contrary opinion, decisions, and orders of competent authorities or courts. We hope to have assisted you on the matter. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: GAN Underse tary Local Government OSEC/EMA/LLLS-LRALLD/rjki Page 2 of 2
